title: Fixed dialogue preference parsing response
description: Structural validation for the actual parser output. Verbatim evidence and consistency with the dialogue require separate checks.

trial_id.description: Copy the identifier from the input prompt.

mu0.description: Initial means, ordered as skirt length, skirt silhouette, neckline opening, train length, and sleeve length. Use 0 for a dimension not explicitly expressed in the opening statement. Use null if a numerical value cannot be interpreted, with a reason in evidence.mu0.

fixed.description: Color and fabric extracted from the opening statement using the canonical terms in protocol/attribute_codes.json.

z.description: Answers for rounds 1 through 5. B is positive, A is negative, and each stated step equals 0.25 units. Use null when an answer cannot be interpreted, with a reason in evidence.z.

mu0.description: For each nonzero initial mean, a nonempty verbatim excerpt from the opening statement. Null is permitted for a zero value. If the numerical value is null because it cannot be interpreted, give the reason here.

fixed.description: Verbatim excerpts from the opening statement supporting color and fabric.

z.description: Verbatim excerpts from the corresponding customer answers. If a numerical value cannot be interpreted, give the reason in its corresponding evidence entry.
